data.user_prompt: Who is Jason Zhu (jasonzhu.ai) and what does GoSail Club do?

sections.text:
Jason Zhu is a former AI algorithm engineer who now focuses on AI applications, content creation, enterprise AI training, technical consulting, and AI-focused media/MCN operations. He runs JasonZhu.AI, where he publishes AI tool reviews, tutorials, industry news, and guidance for founders building for global markets.[2][3]

## What GoSail Club does

GoSail Club is presented as an **AI “going-global” community** for two main groups:[1]

- **Creators and indie builders growing on X:** It offers AI-assisted trend tracking, post drafting, cross-posting, distribution, and creator/MCN support.
- **Forward-deployed engineers and AI consultants:** It provides searchable, curated access to reusable agent skills and workflow resources through the AgentSkillsHub library.

The broader GoSail initiative also includes **GoSail Lab**, an AI MCN and product-promotion operation that helps AI companies with content promotion, KOL collaboration, and international brand expansion.[2][3]

In short, GoSail Club appears to combine a paid community, AI productivity resources, creator growth services, and support for taking AI products to international markets. The listed membership price on JasonZhu.AI is ¥365 per year.[2]
